description_expanded:
Grayton Beach!

.3 mile to Grayton Dunes Beach Access

3 bedrooms, 2 baths

Dog-friendly

Spacious, screened-in front porch

2 bikes

Gas grill

Salty Sisters by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 In the heart of historic Grayton Beach, the quaint and distinguished home is ideal for up to 10 beachgoers. Enjoy biking or walking through the beautiful neighborhood full of old oaks and vintage homes. The abundance of wood floors and walls feels warm and inviting, giving the very spacious, open living and dining area a cozy lake house vibe. Also on the main level is a full bath, large porches, and a sunroom. Upstairs, the 3 bedrooms share an oversized hall bath, complete with a tub/shower combo. An outdoor shower, gas grill, and included bikes, along with its proximity to the beach, local eateries, and bike trails, will help make your stay memorable. We’re excited to have you stay with us! Welcome! Our dedicated team at Oversee 30A, a local company, is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional. We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance.

Reach out to us anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line. Overview: - 600 steps (.3 mile) to the beach (Grayton Dunes Access-ADA accessible) - 3 bedroom, 2 bath - 2,730 sq ft - Gas grill - Wi-Fi - 2 bikes included - Dogs considered, an additional $210 nonrefundable fee for each dog Overnight: - King in primary bedroom; shared hall bath with shower/tub combo; TV (32") - Queen in guest room; shared bath with shower/tub combo - 2 twins and twin bunk in guest room; shared bath shower/tub combo Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Check-out is 10:00 AM CST.
